# 🏎️ F1 PRE-RACE BRIEFING: HUNGARIAN GRAND PRIX
**Location**: Hungaroring | **Date**: 2026-07-26

---

### 📌 KEY WEEKEND HIGHLIGHTS & STRATEGY FORECAST
- **[Strategy] Tyre Degradation Forecast** (*2 Pit Stops Expected*)
  High thermal degradation expected on rear tyres. C3/C4 compounds will demand early management in Sector 2 long sweeping turns.

- **[Circuit DNA] Overtaking & Safety Car Probability** (*68% SC Risk*)
  Historical Safety Car intervention rate is 68%. Main overtaking zone is DRS Zone 1 into Turn 1 with a 380m braking zone.

- **[Title Race] Championship Stakes** (*45 Pts Gap Top 2*)
  Leader holds a margin at the top of WDC standings. A win here extends the lead heading into the summer break.

- **[Pitstop] Pit Loss Delta** (*21.8s Pit Loss*)
  Average pit lane traversal time is 21.8 seconds under green flag, dropping to 13.5 seconds under Virtual Safety Car.
